confidence_notes: Overall medium. Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on Numbeo's crowd-sourced Bucharest averages (undated snapshot) converted from lei at an assumed ~4.4 lei per USD, which is general knowledge and not sourced. Dorm bed comes from BudgetYourTrip and Hostelz averages. Private hostel room and both hotel anchors are low-confidence judgement from sparse KAYAK deal and average figures that do not separate star levels. Cocktail (about 3x the beer anchor) and wine glass (about 1.3x the beer anchor) are estimated from the local beer relationship, not direct price data. The FX value was not read directly from rba.gov.au; it came from search results attributing 0.6955 for 2026-10-15 to RBA 4pm data, and another source gave 0.6922 for the same day, so verify against the RBA F11.1 table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Direct basis for Bucharest: Numbeo city averages for inexpensive meal, mid-range meal for two, cappuccino and draft beer; hostel dorm averages from BudgetYourTrip and Hostelz; private hostel room from scattered hostel listings (roughly $29-31 starting or weekday rates); hotel averages from KAYAK. Cocktail and wine use the beer ratio. Hotel 1-star and 3-star are judgement points set above the hostel private anchor and below the KAYAK all-star average.
